preview.chartNote: Each line is scaled logarithmically on its own. Level factor % = (benefit gain of the level ÷ base value) ÷ (cost of the level ÷ base cost). Total factor % = (1 + benefit gain so far ÷ base value) ÷ (1 + cost so far ÷ base cost), i.e. including the initial value and initial cost. Base cost = cost of the first level.

system.title: System values
table.clean: Every value can be edited individually; dependent values are recalculated immediately. Only “Apply table” takes them into the chart.
table.desc.cost: Cost to get from the previous level to this one (before room factor). Editable.
table.desc.costFactor: Cost of this level compared to the base cost (cost of the first level). 1 = same, 2 = twice as expensive. Editable: adjusts the cost.
table.desc.effect: Value of this level relative to the base value (level 0). ×1 = start, ×1.5 = 50% more. Editable: adjusts the increment.
table.desc.factor: Relative gain per 1,000 cost of this level. Higher is better. Editable: adjusts the cost, the increment stays.
table.desc.gain: Increment of this level relative to the value before, in percent. Editable: adjusts the increment.
table.desc.increment: Value change of this level, absolute or as factor to the value before (switchable). Editable.
table.desc.level: Upgrade level. Level 0 is the starting state without any purchase.
table.desc.stepRatio: Is this level worth it? Benefit gain relative to the base value divided by its cost relative to the base cost. 100% = fair, more = good deal. Editable: adjusts the cost.
table.desc.sum: Sum of all level costs up to and including this level. Editable: adjusts this level's cost.
table.desc.sumFactor: Total cost up to here compared to the base cost. Editable: adjusts this level's cost.
table.desc.totalRatio: Is everything up to here worth it? Total benefit relative to the base value divided by all costs relative to the base cost. Editable: adjusts this level's cost.
table.desc.value: Effect on this level. Changing it adjusts this level's increment. Editable.
table.dirty: Unapplied changes. The chart and the game still show the applied values.
table.roomNote: The table shows values before the room factor ×{factor}; it additionally applies to costs in the chart and analysis.
table.title: Value table
